'''Hayakawa Shrine''' (速川神社) refers to several Shinto shrines.

* '''Hayakawa Shrine''' - A [[Shikinaisha]] located in [[Etchū Province]], [[Imizu District, Toyama|Imizu District]].
''' '''[[Hayakawa Shrine (Himi)]]''' - A proposed site of the above. Located in Himi City, Toyama Prefecture.
''' '''[[Hayakawa Shrine (Takaoka)]]''' - Another proposed site of the above. Located in Takaoka City, Toyama Prefecture.
''' '''[[Hayakawa Hachiman Shrine]]''' - Another related shrine. Located in Takaoka City, Toyama Prefecture.
* '''[[Hayakawa Shrine (Saito)]]''' - Located in Saito City, Miyazaki Prefecture.
